selection_rule: User-requested model-driven allocation using the predictive champion and constrained MILP; not a claim of historical policy superiority.
forecast_selection: Retain the profit model selected by prior-campaign factual RMSE; this allocation change does not refit or retune its predictions.
holdout_design: Existing uniform random 5% measurement holdout; stratified selection has only been discussed, not adopted.
validation_requirement: Compare all allocation candidates using the same MILP allocator, constraints, and earlier-campaign data; report the development winner separately from the deployment decision.
optimality_claim: The primary MILP must solve to optimality within numerical tolerances; secondary tie-breaking may sacrifice at most the documented dollar tolerance.
